candidate_tasks.title: Enforce EnterWorktree schema, name/path gates, and active-session rejection
implementation_steps: Mirror TS accepted fields and unknown-field rejection.
Reject nested active worktree sessions.
Validate name/path mutual exclusivity and slug constraints.
acceptance: Nested EnterWorktree fails before git mutations.
Invalid names and name+path inputs fail with TS-shaped errors.

candidate_tasks.title: Align branch, path, base-ref, and resume semantics with TS
implementation_steps: Resolve main repo root and base ref like TS.
Support entering/resuming named worktrees and existing paths where TS supports them.
Preserve original HEAD/base metadata for ExitWorktree.
acceptance: Named worktree reuse, path entry, and base-ref selection match TS fixtures.

candidate_tasks.title: Return TS-shaped structured EnterWorktree output and model-facing text
implementation_steps: Separate internal metadata from model-visible result.
Return branch/path/session fields using TS names only.
Normalize no-op/resume messages to TS text.
acceptance: Result object and rendered text match TS golden cases.

candidate_tasks.title: Propagate session cwd, context, caches, and resume state after entering worktree
implementation_steps: Switch session cwd through the central runtime context.
Refresh prompt, memory, permission, search, and file-read caches that depend on cwd.
Persist enough session state for resume and ExitWorktree.
acceptance: Subsequent tools run from the worktree cwd.
Resume restores active worktree context without stale main-checkout caches.

candidate_tasks.title: Implement hook-based EnterWorktree lifecycle for non-git or custom isolation
implementation_steps: Invoke TS-equivalent create hooks when git worktree cannot be used or hooks are configured.
Validate hook payloads and outputs.
Record hook-created worktrees for ExitWorktree.
acceptance: Hook-created worktrees enter successfully and can later be kept/removed through ExitWorktree.

candidate_tasks.title: Add post-create setup, sparse-checkout handling, and rollback semantics
implementation_steps: Run TS-equivalent post-create setup steps.
Handle sparse checkout and checkout failures fail-closed.
Roll back partial worktree creation on errors.
acceptance: Partial creation leaves no active session state.
Sparse checkout and setup failures are reported with cleanup status.

candidate_tasks.title: Add EnterWorktree parity tests for git, hook, resume, and failure branches
implementation_steps: Use temporary git repos and hook fixtures.
Cover creation, reuse, existing path entry, invalid names, rollback, and resume.
acceptance: Parity tests cover all entry branches before future implementation subtasks are marked complete.

candidate_tasks.title: Add EnterWorktree remote/context prompt and registry metadata parity
implementation_steps: Update runtime prompt context, registry visibility, destructive metadata, and tool descriptions so EnterWorktree appears and behaves like TS.
acceptance: Tool metadata and prompt context match TS.
Worktree state is visible to downstream tools without leaking Go-only fields.
